releaseNotes: Fix: touch release events now report the last valid touch position instead of (0,0), and touch coordinates are clamped before sending -- a resistive-touch edge overshoot could previously wrap to a huge, meaningless coordinate (e.g. y=63872 instead of a small negative value near 0). Together these made swipe/tap gesture detection unreliable to non-functional on affected units.
